'''August 2001 Austin tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Austin, Texas on 4 August 2001. It is known from Jacob Taylor's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2782">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-08-04-austin-texas-8-04-01d2782/ austin-texas-8-04-01], DeckTech (Jacob "Armaedes" Taylor, 4 August 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-08-04-austin-texas-8-04-01d2782/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 4 August 2001
* '''Site:''' Austin, Texas
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Tatooine]]
